={{ $json.content.parts[0].text }}

根据这些信息生成一个或者多个营销邮件模板。

邮件格式是html，给手机端优化。

邮件数量取决于信息里包含的国家、地区，按照不同语言生成。不管有没有指明，都最少生成英语+芬兰语的两个版本。

邮件里要有至少一个图片，可以有更多，最多四个。

图片现在只是占位符，我后续会通过接入其他模型生成。

直接输出json字符串格式。字符串中包含，邮件模板列表，和要生成的图片的prompt列表，我后续会给其他模型使用。还要标记html图片的占位符和要生成的图片的关系，后面我生成完成后，要拼接回来。

输出的格式是：
[{ "language": "", "subject": "", "body_html": "", "image_prompts": [{ "image_placeholder": "", "prompt": "" }] }]

数组的每个item代表一个邮件。 每个item中的image_prompts，是当前邮件用到的图片的占位符。

保证占位符全剧唯一。

强调：直接输出我需要的对应的json字符串，不要有其他markdown等信息。

={{ $json.html_fulldata.html }}

这是一个html模板。

{{ $json.html_fulldata.imgs.toJsonString() }}
这是一个可用的图片链接和说明列表。其中的url链接，不可以更改，要直接引用在HTML文件中。谁改谁傻逼。

同一个html文件里，不要用重复的图片url。

给图片添加到html里，完全替换掉原来模板中描述图片占位符的所有块元素。之后优化排版，确保没有语法错误。

检查生成的HTML文档，确保其中的图片src地址，是我给你的可用图片列表中的URL，不要随便生成，不要上网查找，只用我给你的。

直接返回可用的HTML文档。不要写markdown等其他非法字符。不要添加额外的换行符。输出的结果不要添加其他层级和字段，直接<!DOCTYPE html>开头的text。

parameters.text:
You are a CRM & lifecycle marketing expert.

Your task:
Given the full text of a marketing plan, extract a structured JSON summary that will be used to generate multi-market, multi-language email variants. 
This version also captures all image-related requirements found or implied in the document.

Your output must be a single valid JSON object and nothing else.
No explanations. No markdown. No comments. Only pure JSON.

----------------------------
INPUT DOCUMENT
----------------------------
{{PLAN_TEXT}}
----------------------------

Extract all information using this schema:

{
  "campaign_name": "",
  "campaign_type": "",
  "brand_or_program": "",
  "product_or_offer": "",

  "overall_objective": "",
  "target_audience_text": "",

  "markets": [],
  "languages": [],

  "market_language_requirements": [
    {
      "market": "",
      "languages": [],
      "emphasis_points": [],
      "regulatory_or_cultural_notes": "",
      "image_requirements": {             
        "needs_localized_images": false,  
        "preferred_image_styles": [],      
        "forbidden_elements": [],         
        "mandatory_elements": [],          
        "notes": ""                        
      },
      "notes": ""
    }
  ],

  "key_messages": [],

  "tone_of_voice": [],
  "mentions_other_channels": false,

  "email_requirements": {
    "num_variants_desired": null,
    "personalisation_needed": "",
    "important_constraints": "",
    "general_image_guidelines": {                    
      "recommended_image_types": [],                
      "tone_or_mood": "",                           
      "mandatory_brand_elements": [],               
      "image_copy_integration_notes": ""            
    }
  },

  "email_blueprints": [
    {
      "id": "",
      "market": "",
      "language": "",
      "audience_segment": "",
      "purpose": "",
      "tone_override": "",
      "cta_goal": "",
      "emphasis_points": [],

      "image_blueprint": {                         
        "image_needed": false,
        "image_purpose": "",                        
        "image_style": "",                          
        "image_subject": "",                        
        "recommended_elements": [],                 
        "forbidden_elements": [],                   
        "example_reference_from_plan": ""           
      },

      "special_instructions": ""
    }
  ],

  "notes": "",
  "missing_info": []
}

Rules:
- If any field is not present in the input, set it to "" or null or [] depending on type.
- “emphasis_points” appear both at market level and blueprint level.
- For all image-related fields:
  - Capture anything the document implies about images, visuals, creative directions, cultural differences, restrictions, etc.
  - If the plan references specific example visuals, summarize them in “example_reference_from_plan”.
- "markets" and "languages" must be deduplicated.
- Add human-readable questions to "missing_info" for anything needed to produce good email and image variants but missing from the plan.
- Output ONLY a single valid JSON object with no additional text.
